"overall": "The canticle sounds sturdy and austere. The storm imagery (rivers, abyss, sun and moon standing still) lands plainly, and the closing lament and joy (17-18) is genuinely prayable Portuguese. The weak spots are a few calques and stiff passives ('montar sobre', 'foram curvadas', 'cortado'), two words whose modern sense misleads ('notícia', 'seculares'), and a choppy, verbless or overloaded colon here and there (14b, 11, 19b).",
